definitions.explanation: Physically falling from a height, such as from a building, cliff, or elevated place.
A figurative fall in status, position, or circumstances, such as falling into poverty or losing one's social standing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: An accident occurred where someone fell from a cliff while mountaineering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Safety nets were installed to prevent falls at the construction site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わった→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
examples.english: He experienced a downfall in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三位|さんい}→三位：26221_sani⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They dropped from first place to third.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさんで、⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転落|てんらく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Debts piled up and he fell into a life of poverty.

notes:
Used for both literal physical falls (sense 1) and figurative decline (sense 2). The physical sense often appears in news reports about accidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転落|てんらく}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ — falling accident
- {転落|てんらく}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ — death from a fall
- {転落|てんらく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ — fall prevention
- {転落|てんらく}⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧ — a life in decline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧ — falling (of objects, more neutral/scientific)
- ⟦{墜落|ついらく}→墜落：18763_tsuiraku⟧ — crash (specifically aircraft or from great height)
- ⟦{没落|ぼつらく}→没落：15873_botsuraku⟧ — ruin, downfall (only figurative, especially of families or aristocracy)
